table.retrieve:
SELECT Item.Name,  
			aliasname=item.customicode, 
			active=CASE item.active WHEN 1 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END,
         Item.purprice,   
         Item.PackUnits,   
         QTY = sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty),   
         Manufacturer.name,
			classname=itemclass.name,
			Category=itemcategory.name,
			UnitPrice = Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / Item.PackUnits, 2),
			unittax=round(max(item.packsalestax)/item.packunits,2),
			packtax=max(item.packsalestax),
			packsaleprice=max(item.saleprice),
			taxval=round(max(item.packsalestax)/item.packunits,2) * sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty), 




                     	
			PackQty = Round(sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty) / Item.packUnits, 2),
         StockValue = Sum(GodownDetail.CurrQty) *
                      Case :ai_pricetype 
								 WHEN 2 THEN Round(Item.purprice / Item.PackUnits, 2)
                     	 WHEN 1 THEN Round(max(Item.Saleprice) / Item.PackUnits, 2)
                     	 WHEN 3 THEN Round(max(Item.avgprice), 2)
                     END

    FROM 
			Manufacturer,   
			Item 
			LEFT OUTER JOIN GodownDetail ON ( Item.ICode = GodownDetail.ICode)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemClass ON ( Item.ICCode = ItemClass.ICCode),
			ItemCategory

   WHERE 
         ( Item.ManfCode IN (:manfcode ) ) and
			( Manufacturer.manfcode = Item.ManfCode ) and
			( Item.icatcode=itemcategory.icatcode) and
			( Item.active=1)

GROUP BY Item.name,item.customicode, Item.Active,Item.purprice, Item.PackUnits, Manufacturer.name,itemcategory.name,
			Itemclass.name
